areas.name: Timah City
areas.notes: city in the tropical portion of the region, at the heart of the Tosa Reserve. Gym leader is Hana – she cultivates Orchids in her garden.

areas.name: Senoko City
areas.notes: Mo, runs the national power grid. He looks after the wind farms that dot around this town.

areas.name: Inka City
areas.notes: Gym leader Frea heads up a cold food distribution centre here. Inka City is the domestic logistics hub of the city, and Frea makes sure all the imported food from Hoenn and Johto gets on the plates of the Tosa people. Team Torrent's hidden base is here, with a shipping company as the front (Marlin Co.)

areas.name: Moongrove City
areas.notes: Nestled in the mangroves, gym leader Tork enjoys hunting for catfish.

areas.name: Corral City
areas.notes: the bustling beach city on Pokétopia where Marina's gym resides. There's also a lovely marina.

areas.name: Route 306
areas.notes: A short, pleasant path for people commuting from Changu City to Changu Airport.

areas.name: Moongrove Marsh
areas.notes: marshlands and mangroves that weave themselves around Moongrove city. Great for fishing up ellusive Pokémon species, and some haunting ghost Pokémon at night.

areas.name: Power Plant
areas.notes: This replaces the existing power plant.

areas.name: Abandoned House
areas.notes: A mysterious house abandoned in the early days of the Tosa region. People in Moongrove spot lights here at night. It's haunted.

areas.name: Bura City
areas.notes: A quiet city people spend little time in. It's mostly a place for people to stop over on journeys between Changu and Juran city.

areas.name: Damp Path
areas.notes: A wet abandoned path through the hills of West Tosa. Filled with rowdy thugs and neverdowells now. And Zubat.

areas.name: Wavebreak Town
areas.notes: A forgotten seaside town. Home to Tosa's first port before Tosa Port opened.

areas.name: Faber Town
areas.notes: A town nestled in the cliffs of the Tosa region accessible via cable car or a trecherous climb up the cliff. The leader of the town is Meru, a fierce fighter who trains against Rock Pokémon in the mountains solo.

areas.name: Galangal Forest
areas.notes: A range of medicinal plants grow in Galangal Forest.

areas.name: Kantu Falls
areas.notes: A beautiful series of waterfalls near Faber Town, locals travel here once or twice a year to bathe in the mineral-rich waters.

areas.name: Railway Tunnels
areas.notes: Dingy tunnels beneath Tosa Port railway station.
